name: DHL Supply Chain - Campbell Soup DC - Fort Worth TX

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (ROOFTOP, moved 89m) landed on the building. Confirmed as the DHL/Campbell Soup Supply Company DC at 3000 Cantrell Sansom Rd, Fort Worth (AllianceTexas area), ~578,000 sq ft - Aug-2025 Street View shows the building marked '3000' with US/Texas flags.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entrance on the NW side, reached by a long (~250m+) divided internal drive running south from Cantrell Sansom Road between the Campbell DC and the neighboring warehouse.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Confirmed at z20 satellite - a small white guard booth with a dark canopy roof straddling the truck lane, fenced, with a trailer staged just south of it. Classic guard-shack footprint.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach drive from the public road to the guard shack and a deep truck court inside - easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock building with continuous dock-door rhythm on BOTH long faces (west and east); ~50+ doors per face, ~100 total estimate, banded 50+. Low-confidence exact count.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on the two opposite long faces strongly suggest separate shipping/receiving operations; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer drop rows along both the west and east dock aprons; ~115 trailers visible across the site.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide internal entrance drive and large truck court with unused paved width - room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box ~520m N-S x ~210m E-W of the fenced parcel; bounded east by I-35W with a treed buffer.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approx 115 trailers counted across both dock faces and drop rows.
